engineering_assessments.assessment: One original E0 prediction runs from current images, pre-step templates/history and the previous predicted box. The observer returns the original result object and snapshots914 features before the tracker replaces its history. Primary16x16 features are sampled at a3x3 grid centered on the final normalized cxcywh prediction, using grid_sample align_corners=False and explicit crop coverage. The head reads only these features with fixed normalization; no GT or future frame enters the commit decision. GT is used for initialization and later saved/scored outputs. No additional E0 NN forward is added by the guard; M1 adds its own small head and observer work.

The original write condition is unchanged: tracker.frame divisible by5 and confidence>=0.65. Argmax state0 allows the original write; state1/2 restores only templates[:,1] from its pre-step clone. Both modality portions of that dynamic slot are restored; slot0, returned box/route, predicted state, history, frame and since_query are not rolled back. Observe mode never restores a template. close restores the original predictor binding. CPU tests force a rejected write, an accepted write and lost-state observe mode. Future predictions may change through retained template differences, which is the intended ablation.

Both observe and guard drafts require first31 frames of TRAIN2up/motocross/carturn, disjoint from manifest dev/test names. Each of90 tracked steps clones the current tracker pre-state into an observer-disabled E0 shadow. It compares raw returned boxes, all route fields except measured seconds, history and counters, and full templates after applying the same intended rollback to the shadow. Observe parity implies an unchanged prefix trajectory; guard parity establishes only this step's unchanged output/state plus the declared template rollback from the current guard state. It does not compare guard's complete trajectory to a separately evolving ungated trajectory.

Factory and parent checkpoint identities are bound, both model loads are strict, model/head are eval with gradients disabled, and full state dictionaries are compared at completion with all gradients None. No optimizer/backward is present. TF32 and cuDNN benchmark are disabled. Outer CUDA synchronization includes M1 inference and rollback. Initialization is timed; model loading/file output are excluded. Route.seconds retains original tracker scope. Reported timing is concurrent-load service time, not isolated throughput.
